skill.name: developer-growth-analysis
skill.description: Analyzes your recent Claude Code chat history to identify coding patterns, development gaps, and areas for improvement, curates relevant learning resources from HackerNews, and automatically sends a personalized growth report to your Slack DMs.
skill.summary: Analyzes Claude Code history to identify developer growth patterns and learning priorities.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: Most external command detections are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code examples. Confirmed risks are privacy-related: the skill reads Claude Code history from a hidden home file and sends derived reports through Slack. No prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The skill reads private Claude Code history from a hidden home-directory file.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation, limit the date range, and redact pasted content before analysis.

remediation.issue: The skill sends a derived report to Slack direct messages.
remediation.suggestion: Show a preview and require opt-in before any Slack delivery.

remediation.issue: Search queries are derived from private work patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Generalize query terms before using external search tools and avoid project names or sensitive topics.

content.user_title: Analyze Developer Growth From Claude Code
content.value_statement: Developers often miss patterns in their recent AI-assisted work. This skill reviews Claude Code history and builds a focused growth report with resources.
actual_capabilities: Reads recent Claude Code chat history from the local history file.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, and repeated challenges.
Creates prioritized improvement areas with evidence from recent work.
Builds a Markdown growth report with strengths, actions, and learning resources.
Uses HackerNews searches to find articles related to improvement areas.
Can send the final report to the user's Slack direct messages.
limitations: It depends on access to local Claude Code history.
It may miss work that happened outside recent Claude Code chats.
HackerNews results can vary by search availability and relevance.
Slack delivery requires an active and authorized Slack connection.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Learning Gaps
use_cases.description: Find recurring issues in recent coding sessions and turn them into focused study areas.

use_cases.title: Prepare Coaching Notes
use_cases.description: Summarize growth patterns before a mentoring session or one-on-one discussion.

use_cases.title: Plan Weekly Skill Work
use_cases.description: Build a practical weekly learning plan from recent project evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze My Recent Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my developer growth from my recent Claude Code chats.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you want a general review.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Today
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my work from today and suggest areas for improvement.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this after a focused work session.

prompt_templates.title: Review Two Days
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my last 48 hours of Claude Code history and identify three prioritized growth areas.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a short weekly planning window.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Send Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the last two days, find HackerNews resources, and send the growth report to my Slack DMs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when Slack delivery is desired.

output_examples.input: Analyze my developer growth from today.
output: Work summary with projects, technologies, and problem types.
Prioritized improvement areas with observed evidence.
Action items and selected learning resources.

output_examples.input: Find growth areas from the last two days and send them to Slack.
output_examples.output: A structured report covering strengths, gaps, action items, learning resources, and Slack delivery status.

best_practices: Run the skill after a focused work session or weekly review.
Review the report before sharing it outside your personal workspace.
Use specific time windows when you want tighter evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to evaluate another developer without consent.
Do not send reports to Slack channels that include private project details.
Do not treat inferred growth gaps as formal performance review evidence.

faq.question: What history does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes recent Claude Code chat history from the local history file.

faq.question: Can it analyze work outside Claude Code?
faq.answer: Only if that work appears in the recent Claude Code chat history.

faq.question: Does it provide learning resources?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches HackerNews for articles related to the identified improvement areas.

faq.question: Can it send reports to Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. Slack delivery requires an active authorized connection through the configured tool.

faq.question: Is the report a formal performance review?
faq.answer: No. It is a personal learning aid based on recent chat evidence.

faq.question: What should users review before delivery?
faq.answer: Users should review sensitive project names, pasted content, and private work details.
